comments.body: **merge-train (2026-11-17): on the train as is.** Validated at `8412b87f4`; the router's 1..ceiling check and the clamp in `capacity_manager.acquire` remain the bounds once the db-layer cap goes. Two notes, not blocking: the body's "the router is the only caller" is not quite right (a second caller exists and passes 1, so it is unaffected), and no test drives the router hand-off the issue suggested (ceiling 32, PUT 16, expect 200 and effective 16) — a good follow-up test.
